learningObjective: Read two thresholds as three action regions and see why asymmetric error costs make automatic decisions expensive near the review region.
mediumRationale: A deterministic SVG policy strip makes score position, region width, two exact boundaries, and opposing false-action costs spatially comparable in one static view. Mermaid was rejected because the lesson is quantitative geometry rather than flow; semantic HTML would separate values but weaken the continuous score model; interaction would add controls without improving the fixed policy lesson; paper-figure reuse was unnecessary and licensing was not established; mixed media would add complexity; and no visual would leave the three-region mental model implicit.

pages.insight: The logistic-regression material distinguishes class probabilities from the loss used to fit them, which is necessary before applying a probability policy.
The ROC material presents threshold selection as an operating-point tradeoff between true-positive benefit and false-positive cost.
The imbalanced classification example shows why an operating policy must account for the different consequences of false positives and false negatives.
The calibration and out-of-distribution material connects meaningful confidence values to low-confidence rejection.

deckReview.notes: The deck was reviewed independently across slides 32 through 39. It motivates calibrated scores, cost-sensitive operating points, and rejection, but does not combine them into a two-threshold action policy. The new figure supplies that missing synthesis with an original illustrative policy.

sourceReview.notes: Primary sources were reviewed independently of the deck. The visual is an original construction from the article's illustrative 0.60 and 0.98 policy; it reproduces no paper-specific layout, data, or empirical result.

agentReview.summary: Recommended one static SVG policy strip with patterned regions, explicit threshold lines, and opposing cost callouts. This preserves the score continuum while making abstention a first-class action rather than a confidence failure.

implementation.accessibility: The SVG provides a title and long description. Region names, numeric endpoints, distinct hatch patterns, solid threshold lines, and direct cost labels preserve the lesson without color; a compact viewBox scales to the reading column and the caption restates the policy in text.
